svg.title: TASK-253 Staff directory filter proposal, round 1
svg.desc: Illustrative Aria ERP Staff directory after mockups for desktop and mobile, showing persistent employee search and department filters, employment status and job title filters, employee counts, a horizontally scrollable mobile results table, and an example empty-filter state.
svg.text: Round 1 · Illustrative UI based on the supplied live screenshots
Search · department · employment status · job title

g.text: · All departments · Current and former employees

svg.text: Search and department remain visible behind the sheet.
Current + Former are included by default.
Try another status or job title. Your search stays available.
Clear selections returns to all departments, current + former, and all job titles.
